cobbleeffort.species.abbadomon.desc: A shape of black ribbons wound round an empty core and covered in staring red eyes. It is said to be made of everything that was ever deleted, and it pulls the light out of any world it drifts into.
cobbleeffort.species.abbadomon.name: Abbadomon
cobbleeffort.species.abbadomoncore.desc: The core of Abbadomon, unwound: a cloaked knight of tattered eye-ribbons with a crimson blade for an arm. Whatever it cuts is not destroyed but erased, as if it had never been.
cobbleeffort.species.abbadomoncore.name: Abbadomon Core
cobbleeffort.species.achillesmon.desc: A warrior who has never once been struck. It hurls its golden spear faster than sound, and the cyan wings on its heels carry it out of reach before anyone can strike back.
cobbleeffort.species.achillesmon.name: Achillesmon
cobbleeffort.species.aegiochusmon.desc: A god-man with goat's legs who carries a storm on its back. Its fists come down with the force of a lightning strike, and the ground cracks wherever it plants its hooves.
cobbleeffort.species.aegiochusmon.name: Aegiochusmon
cobbleeffort.species.aegiochusmonblue.de: Aegiochusmon in blue cyber-armour, with a gauntlet many times its own size hovering beside it. The gauntlet can catch a falling meteor and throw it back.
cobbleeffort.species.aegiochusmondark.de: Aegiochusmon fallen to darkness: black-winged and red-eyed, it reaps its foes with a storm-forged scythe and feeds on their fear.
cobbleeffort.species.aegiochusmongreen.d: Aegiochusmon wreathed in living vines. Its whips are tipped with spiked seed-pods that burst into thickets wherever they land, and a forest grows in its footsteps.
cobbleeffort.species.aegiochusmonholy.de: Aegiochusmon in holy armour of golden gears, a halo over its horns and a sun blazing behind it. Its light drives off the darkness and heals those who fight beside it.
cobbleeffort.species.aegiomon.desc: A young god-man with a goat's horns and legs. It hums a tune through its syrinx that makes anyone who hears it forget everything but Aegiomon, then floors them with a crackling punch.
cobbleeffort.species.aegiomon.name: Aegiomon
cobbleeffort.species.aegisdramon.desc: A golden dragon-ship that guards the deep oceans. Its hull bristles with cannons and lances, and its barrier turns back any attack aimed at the ones it protects.
cobbleeffort.species.aegisdramon.name: Aegisdramon
cobbleeffort.species.aequcedramon.desc: A small blue dragon with a white ruff and wide bat wings. It whips up whirlwinds of frost as it flies, and a hole opens in the sky wherever it goes.
cobbleeffort.species.aequcedramon.name: Aequcedramon
cobbleeffort.species.aerovdramon.desc: A holy dragon that guards the skies, with red wings and white armour over its blue scales. It strikes with a V-shaped blast of light from its chest.
cobbleeffort.species.aerovdramon.name: Aero V-dramon
cobbleeffort.species.agnimon.desc: A warrior of flame in red armour, born from the spirit of fire. It fights with blazing fists and kicks, and its spinning dance of flame burns away any evil.
cobbleeffort.species.agnimon.name: Agnimon
cobbleeffort.species.agumon.desc: A brave little dinosaur Digimon with sharp claws. It spits its Pepper Breath at anything that threatens its friends, and it is always, always hungry.
cobbleeffort.species.agumon.name: Agumon
cobbleeffort.species.agumonblack.desc: A black-scaled Agumon with a fiercer temper. It picks fights with Digimon far bigger than itself and often wins.
cobbleeffort.species.agumonblack.name: Agumon (Black)
cobbleeffort.species.agumonblackxantibod: A black Agumon awakened by the X-Antibody, scarred with red stripes. It breathes a roaring stream of fire and slashes with chrome claws.
cobbleeffort.species.agumonburstmode.des: An Agumon that has turned to pure spirit, glowing pink and floating with its arms spread wide. It is said to appear only when a partner's feelings reach their peak.
cobbleeffort.species.agumonhakase.desc: An Agumon in a mortarboard and a lab coat that drags on the ground. It has read every book in the Digital World and lectures anyone who stands still long enough, pointer in hand.
cobbleeffort.species.agumonhakase.name: Agumon Hakase
cobbleeffort.species.agumonxantibody.des: An Agumon awakened by the X-Antibody, with long chrome claws and a fiercer, more dinosaur-like body. Its Baby Flame burns far hotter than any other Agumon's.
Agumon's courage given a warrior's form by an unbreakable bond. Two great wings of fire cross behind it in an X, and its gauntlet claws shine red-hot.
cobbleeffort.species.aircraftcarrierwham: A whale that carries a whole flight deck on its back. Smaller Digimon live in its island tower, and it launches them into the sky from its runway before charging into battle mouth first.
cobbleeffort.species.airdramon.desc: A winged serpent said to be a messenger of the gods. It stirs up whirlwinds with a beat of its ragged wings and rains spinning needles of wind on anything below.
cobbleeffort.species.airdramon.name: Airdramon
cobbleeffort.species.ajatarmon.desc: A warrior made of living vines that guards the deep forest. It ties intruders up in thorny ivy, then brings its sickle-hatchet down in one swing.
cobbleeffort.species.ajatarmon.name: Ajatarmon
cobbleeffort.species.akatorimon.desc: A giant rooster with a temper as hot as its blazing feathers. One glare from its scarred red eye is enough to make most Digimon back away; the rest meet its charging talons.
cobbleeffort.species.akatorimon.name: Akatorimon
cobbleeffort.species.albatusmon.desc: An armoured angel that judges the wicked. The circle of runes on its staff blazes like the sun, and the sphere of light it calls down erases whatever it touches.
cobbleeffort.species.albatusmon.name: Albatusmon
cobbleeffort.species.aldamon.desc: A warrior who joined the spirits of beast and man into one blazing form. Fire pours from its fists and the flames at its back, and its golden ray-blades cut through solid rock.
cobbleeffort.species.aldamon.name: Aldamon
cobbleeffort.species.algomonadult.desc: A great violet sphere that drags itself along on a skirt of tentacles. Its mechanical gauntlets were built from the programs it swallowed, and its zipped mouth leaks poisonous steam.
cobbleeffort.species.algomonadult.name: Algomon (Adult)
cobbleeffort.species.algomonbabyi.desc: A glossy droplet of living code that floats wherever the network takes it. Its one great eye records everything it sees, and it was born from a program that rewrote itself.
cobbleeffort.species.algomonbabyi.name: Algomon (Baby I)
cobbleeffort.species.algomonbabyii.desc: A spiky ball that scuttles about on four thin legs. It copies the moves of anything it watches, though it gets most of them a little wrong.
cobbleeffort.species.algomonbabyii.name: Algomon (Baby II)
cobbleeffort.species.algomonchild.desc: It floats on a bundle of tentacles and flings bursts of corrupted data from its eye. It learns from every battle and never makes the same mistake twice.
cobbleeffort.species.algomonchild.name: Algomon (Child)
cobbleeffort.species.algomonperfect.desc: A lean hunter whose bodysuit is covered in watching eyes. It whips its tentacles through the network and rewrites any Digimon it catches into a copy of itself.
cobbleeffort.species.algomonperfect.name: Algomon (Perfect)
cobbleeffort.species.algomonultimate.des: The final form of the self-rewriting algorithm, armoured and wild-maned. It is said that no system it has entered has ever been restored.
cobbleeffort.species.allomon.desc: A dinosaur Digimon born from the Digi-Egg of Courage. It bites with a jaw full of fangs and breathes a blast of fire hot enough to melt rock.
cobbleeffort.species.allomon.name: Allomon
cobbleeffort.species.allomonxantibody.de: An Allomon awakened by the X-Antibody, wrapped in a fur mantle and a feathered war bonnet. Its fire breath turns blue-white and its charge can flatten a forest.
cobbleeffort.species.alphamon.desc: The phantom Royal Knight, said to have stood against the others when they lost their way. It wields the Holy Sword Grade Alpha, drawn from a magic circle, and its cape is the shadow of a whole army.
cobbleeffort.species.alphamon.name: Alphamon
cobbleeffort.species.alphamonouryuken.de: Alphamon joined with the spirit of the dragon Ouryumon. Its wings blaze with every colour of flame, and the Ouryuken it carries can split the sky from horizon to horizon.
cobbleeffort.species.alraumon.desc: A mandrake Digimon that dozes half buried in the soil. The scent of its lily lulls attackers to sleep, and its root claws drink the strength from anything they grip.
cobbleeffort.species.alraumon.name: Alraumon
cobbleeffort.species.amaterasumon.desc: The goddess of the sun, who carries two great suns on her back. When she hides herself the whole Digital World falls dark, and when she shines no shadow can stand.
cobbleeffort.species.amaterasumon.name: Amaterasumon
cobbleeffort.species.ambromon.desc: A laughing radish spirit that wanders with its sun staff, blessing the harvest wherever it dances. Its laughter is said to heal any sickness.
cobbleeffort.species.ambromon.name: Ambromon
cobbleeffort.species.amon.desc: A spirit of crimson flame with a demon's face. It burns in the dark places of the network and feeds on the anger of those who come near.
cobbleeffort.species.amon.name: Amon
cobbleeffort.species.amphimon.desc: A cyborg that charges the jellyfish orbs on its tendrils with opposite currents. Bringing them together releases a blast that leaves no machine still running.
cobbleeffort.species.amphimon.name: Amphimon
cobbleeffort.species.ancientbeatmon.desc: The ancient warrior of thunder, one of the Ten Legendary Warriors who sealed away the Lucemon of old. Its scythe horns call down lightning, and its spirit lives on in Beetlemon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientbeatmon.name: Ancient Beatmon
cobbleeffort.species.ancientgarurumon.de: The ancient warrior of light, a wolf knight of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Its blade shines brighter than the moon, and its spirit lives on in Wolfmon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientgreymon.desc: The ancient warrior of flame and leader of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Its wings of fire scorch the earth, and its spirit lives on in Agnimon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientgreymon.name: Ancient Greymon
cobbleeffort.species.ancientirismon.desc: The ancient warrior of wind, one of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Its rainbow wings raise storms, and its rapier strikes faster than the eye can follow. Its spirit lives on in Fairymon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientirismon.name: Ancient Irismon
cobbleeffort.species.ancientmegatheriumo: The ancient warrior of ice, a beast so vast that glaciers were said to be its sleeping body. Its spirit lives on in Chakmon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientmermaimon.de: The ancient warrior of water, who ruled the seas with her trident. Her song calms storms and raises tidal waves. Her spirit lives on in Ranamon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientsphinxmon.de: The ancient warrior of darkness, a sphinx who guarded the boundary between light and shadow. Its spirit lives on in Löwemon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancienttroiamon.des: The ancient warrior of wood, a war-horse built of living timber and armed with cannons. Its spirit lives on in Arbormon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientvolcamon.des: The ancient warrior of earth, a walking volcano with fists like boulders. When it pounds the ground the mountains erupt. Its spirit lives on in Grottomon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientwisemon.desc: The ancient warrior of steel, a sage who weighed the hearts of others on its balance of sun and moon. Its spirit lives on in Mercurymon.
cobbleeffort.species.ancientwisemon.name: Ancient Wisemon
cobbleeffort.species.andiramon.desc: A holy beast with enormous ears that hear every whisper across the land. It moves so fast that its long sleeves seem to strike from everywhere at once.
cobbleeffort.species.andiramon.name: Andiramon
cobbleeffort.species.andiramondeva.desc: Andiramon serving as one of the Twelve Devas, the guardians of the holy beasts. It wears a lilac scarf as the mark of its rank.
cobbleeffort.species.andiramondeva.name: Andiramon (Deva)
cobbleeffort.species.andromon.desc: An android built to be the perfect machine, its chrome frame wrapped round artificial muscle. It fires spinning missiles from its chest and its drum arm can cut a wall in two.
cobbleeffort.species.andromon.name: Andromon
cobbleeffort.species.angemon.desc: An angel warrior with six shining wings. It never removes its helm, and its Heaven's Knuckle can drive any evil back into the dark.
cobbleeffort.species.angemon.name: Angemon
cobbleeffort.species.angewomon.desc: An archangel who shines with holy light. She is gentle with the kind but has no mercy for evil, and her Holy Arrow never misses its mark.
cobbleeffort.species.angewomon.name: Angewomon
Angewomon awakened by the X-Antibody, crowned with a ring of gold light and twelve rainbow wings. Her light alone is enough to drive back the dark.
cobbleeffort.species.angoramon.desc: A plump angora rabbit that dozes almost all day. Its fur is so soft that attacks sink into it, and it can sleep through a whole battle.
cobbleeffort.species.angoramon.name: Angoramon
cobbleeffort.species.anheinuwashou.desc: A dark goddess seen so far only as a shadow on the edge of the Digital World. It is said to be the darkness of the goddess who mended the sky.
cobbleeffort.species.anheinuwashou.name: AnheiNüwashou
cobbleeffort.species.ankylomon.desc: An armoured dinosaur whose spiked shell is harder than diamond. It curls up and rolls at its foes, or smashes them with its mace of a tail.
cobbleeffort.species.ankylomon.name: Ankylomon
cobbleeffort.species.anomalocarimon.desc: An ancient crustacean revived from data of the first seas. It scoops prey in with its curled claws and cuts with the blade-fins down its sides.
cobbleeffort.species.anomalocarimon.name: Anomalocarimon
cobbleeffort.species.anomalocarimonxanti: Anomalocarimon awakened by the X-Antibody, its shell a rainbow and its head crowned with two great scythe blades.
cobbleeffort.species.anubimon.desc: The god who guards the gate between the Digital World and the Dark Area. It weighs the data of every deleted Digimon and decides whether it will be reborn.
cobbleeffort.species.anubimon.name: Anubimon
cobbleeffort.species.apocalymon.desc: Born from the grudges of every Digimon that was deleted without ever evolving. It can use the techniques of any Digimon it has absorbed, and wants only to erase the whole world.
cobbleeffort.species.apocalymon.name: Apocalymon
cobbleeffort.species.apollomon.desc: One of the Olympus Twelve, the god of the sun. Its mane and tail burn with solar flame and its fists strike with the heat of a sunrise.
cobbleeffort.species.apollomon.name: Apollomon
cobbleeffort.species.apollomondarknessmo: Apollomon swallowed completely by darkness. Its flames have gone out, and it swings a great black axe at anything that shines.
Apollomon after the whispers of darkness turned its flames cold and blue. It still burns, but its fire freezes the heart.
cobbleeffort.species.aquilamon.desc: A giant eagle that rules the sky over the plains. It rams its foes with its horns at full speed and fires rings of energy from its beak.
cobbleeffort.species.aquilamon.name: Aquilamon
cobbleeffort.species.arbormon.desc: The warrior of wood, a puppet of carved timber. It fights with stretching arms and legs, and its wooden body shrugs off blows that would break stone.
cobbleeffort.species.arbormon.name: Arbormon
cobbleeffort.species.archelomon.desc: An ancient sea turtle born from the Digi-Egg of Sincerity. It glides through the water on its bladed flippers and ploughs through enemies with its spiked shell.
cobbleeffort.species.archelomon.name: Archelomon
cobbleeffort.species.archnemon.desc: A demon beast who spins webs across the Digital World to catch the unwary. She laughs as she toys with her prey before striking with her spider legs.
cobbleeffort.species.archnemon.name: Archnemon
cobbleeffort.species.arcturusmon.desc: A dragon-man named for a bright star. It drives its spinning drill lances through anything in its way, and its wings blot out the night sky.
cobbleeffort.species.arcturusmon.name: Arcturusmon
cobbleeffort.species.ariemon.desc: A sea sorceress who calls the tides with her shell staff. Her robes trail water wherever she goes, and her spells can raise the ocean floor.
cobbleeffort.species.ariemon.name: Ariemon
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonadult.desc: A gaunt beast that stalks on its huge hands. It grows in leaps by devouring the data of other Digimon, and nothing seems to satisfy its hunger.
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonadult.name: Arkadimon Adult
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonbaby.desc: A small grey creature that skitters on four steel legs. It eats data to grow, and nobody knows what made it.
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonbaby.name: Arkadimon Baby
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonchild.desc: A pink imp that slashes with the blades on its arms. Every Digimon it defeats makes it stronger, for it absorbs their data.
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonchild.name: Arkadimon Child
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonperfect.de: Its shoulders sprout masses of crimson tentacles that seize its prey. It has eaten so much data that it can mimic the techniques of those it devoured.
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonsuperultim: The final form of Arkadimon, a fortress-like head of steel the size of a hill. Its single eye sees every Digimon as food.
cobbleeffort.species.arkadimonultimate.d: The bewitching beast grown into a winged demon. It has devoured whole armies of Digimon and is said to be close to becoming something no one can stop.
cobbleeffort.species.arkhaiangemon.desc: An angel of the rank of Principality, who leads the lesser angels into battle. The flame of its torch never goes out, and evil cannot bear to look at it.
cobbleeffort.species.arkhaiangemon.name: Arkhai Angemon
cobbleeffort.species.armadimon.desc: A cheerful armadillo that rolls into a ball when it is scared, or when it wants to bowl someone over. Its claws can dig through solid rock.
cobbleeffort.species.armadimon.name: Armadimon
cobbleeffort.species.armagemon.desc: The Armageddon of the Digital World, born when countless Digimon fused into one. It crawls over the land on its spindly legs, erasing everything in its path.
cobbleeffort.species.armagemon.name: Armagemon
cobbleeffort.species.armalizamon.desc: A lizard covered in overlapping spiked plates. It curls its tail over its back to strike with the green spear-tip, and its claws crackle with stored energy.
cobbleeffort.species.armalizamon.name: Arma Lizamon
cobbleeffort.species.armamon.desc: A living arsenal whose body is made of weapons. Every blade on it can be drawn and thrown, and it never runs out of swords.
cobbleeffort.species.armamon.name: Armamon
cobbleeffort.species.armamonburstmode.de: Armamon at the peak of its power, its armour turned to burning bronze. A ring of swords floats round it, each ready to strike on its own.
cobbleeffort.species.arresterdramon.desc: A sly dragon-man who hunts treasure across the Digital World. Its anchor-hook tail snatches things from enemies before they notice.
cobbleeffort.species.arresterdramon.name: Arresterdramon
cobbleeffort.species.arresterdramonsuper: Arresterdramon at full power. Its great yellow wings carry it faster than sound, and its tail ends in a golden trident.
Superior Mode armed with the Brave Snatcher, a huge gauntlet that can grab and crush even the strongest Digimon. Its gold ring spins faster the harder it grips.
cobbleeffort.species.artiomon.desc: A bear-beast huntress who guards the forests. Her spear never misses, and she roars loud enough to shake the trees bare.
cobbleeffort.species.artiomon.name: Artiomon
cobbleeffort.species.assaultmon.desc: A cyborg soldier sealed in a heavy mech-suit. It never stops firing its gatling arm, and its gas mask lets it fight through any smoke or poison.
cobbleeffort.species.assaultmon.name: Assaultmon
cobbleeffort.species.astamon.desc: A demon lord who dresses like a gangster and settles every argument with its submachine gun. It is said to keep its word, and to expect the same of everyone else.
cobbleeffort.species.astamon.name: Astamon
cobbleeffort.species.asuramon.desc: A wrathful guardian deity with a mane of flame. Its burning fists strike faster than a hundred blows a second, and it never retreats.
cobbleeffort.species.asuramon.name: Asuramon
cobbleeffort.species.atamadekachimon.des: A dinosaur whose head is far bigger than the rest of it. It can barely walk without toppling over, but anything that ends up in its jaws is never seen again.
cobbleeffort.species.atlurballistamon.de: A beetle-robot heavyweight that charges its fists with lightning. One punch from its giant right hand can knock a mountain flat.
cobbleeffort.species.atlurkabuterimonblu: A hulking insect Digimon that fires lightning from its horns. Its six clawed limbs can tear through steel plate.
cobbleeffort.species.atlurkabuterimonred: A crimson Atlur Kabuterimon whose hide burns hot to the touch. It hurls fireballs from its maw and never backs down from a fight.
cobbleeffort.species.atratusmon.desc: A dark swan-knight whose wings blaze with magenta light. Its crystal shields reflect any attack back at the one who made it.
cobbleeffort.species.atratusmon.name: Atratusmon
cobbleeffort.species.avengekidmon.desc: A dragon-man gunslinger who lives only for revenge. It hunts across the network with its gun-blade and never forgets a single wrong.
cobbleeffort.species.avengekidmon.name: Avenge Kidmon
cobbleeffort.species.azhdarmon.desc: A pterosaur whose crest is a great axe-blade. It dives from the clouds at incredible speed, slicing anything below with its crest and wing blades.
cobbleeffort.species.azhdarmon.name: Azhdarmon
cobbleeffort.species.blitzgreymon.desc: A war-machine Digimon armoured in crimson. Its shoulder cannons and Gatling arms fire without pause until nothing in front of it is left standing.
cobbleeffort.species.blitzgreymon.name: BlitzGreymon
cobbleeffort.species.greymon.desc: A giant dinosaur Digimon whose skull is armoured with a helmet of hardened bone. Its Mega Flame melts rock; even a herd of the strongest beasts scatters when it roars.
cobbleeffort.species.greymon.name: Greymon
cobbleeffort.species.koromon.desc: A baby Digimon that hatched from a Digitama not long ago. It bounces about on its round body, blowing bubbles at anything it doesn't like the look of.
cobbleeffort.species.koromon.name: Koromon
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymon.desc: Half its body has been rebuilt in metal. The hatch on its chest opens to fire Giga Destroyer, two organic missiles that can level a mountain, and its Trident Arm tears through steel.
cobbleeffort.species.metalgreymon.name: MetalGreymon
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalterb.desc: Omegamon Alter-S consumed by its own power: its armour has turned black, and red light leaks from every seam. Its Grey Sword and Garuru Cannon are said to be able to erase a whole world.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalterb.name: Omegamon Alter-B
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalters.desc: A holy knight Digimon in white armour. With the sword on one arm it cuts through anything; with the cannon in the lion's jaws on the other, it fires blasts of absolute cold.
cobbleeffort.species.omegamonalters.name: Omegamon Alter-S
cobbleeffort_digital.digitama.not_ready: The Digitama is still warming up (%s%%).
cobbleeffort_digital.digitama.ready: It's moving! Use it to hatch.
cobbleeffort_digital.digitama.warming: Warming up: %s%%. Keep it in your inventory.
cobblemon.move.garurucannon.desc: The user fires a blast of absolute cold from the cannon in its lion's jaws. It may freeze the target.
cobblemon.move.gigadestroyer.desc: The hatch on the user's chest opens and fires two great missiles at the target.
cobblemon.move.greysword.desc: The user cuts the target with a sword that splits anything. Critical hits land more easily.
cobblemon.move.megaflame.desc: The user breathes a huge, blazing fireball at the target. It may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.pepperbreath.desc: The user spits a ball of fire at the target. It may leave the target with a burn.
item.cobbleeffort_digital.digiball.toolt: Three times as good as a Poké Ball on Digimon.
